# What VellumPdf implements of PDF 2.0

ISO 32000-2 is large, and "supports PDF 2.0" is a claim nobody can check. This table is one
anybody can: every document the standard cites, every feature it says it added, and every key it
deprecated, each with what this library does about it.

It is generated from two datasets the PDF Association publishes, plus the specification's own
clause 0.3. Regenerate with `python eng/generate-pdf20-inventory.py`.

> **This is a coverage inventory, not a conformance test.** Whether output actually conforms is
> decided by the veraPDF profiles the test suite runs against, not by this page.

## What PDF 2.0 deprecated

Also clause 0.3. A file declaring `%PDF-2.0` should not carry these — which makes this table a
statement about correctness, not coverage.

| Deprecated | This library | Issue |
| --- | --- | --- |
| XFA, including NeedsRendering | Never written. |  |
| Movie, Sound and TrapNet annotations | Never written. |  |
| Movie and Sound actions | Never written. |  |
| Info dictionary | **Written today** — Title, Author, Subject, Keywords, Creator, Producer. | #325 |
| Assistive technology restrictions via DRM | Never written. |  |
| ProcSet | **Written today** on every page (PdfPage.cs:107). | #325 |
| OS-specific file specifications | No file specifications written at all yet; must not emit /DOS /Mac /Unix. | #242 |
| OS-specific additions to Launch actions | Never written. |  |
| Names for XObjects | Never written. |  |
| Names for fonts | Never written. |  |
| Arrays of blend modes | Never written. |  |
| Alternate presentations | Never written. |  |
| Open prepress interface | Never written. |  |
| CharSet for Type 1 fonts | Never written. |  |
| CIDSet for CID fonts | Never written. |  |
| Prepress viewer preferences | Never written. |  |
| NeedAppearances | **Written today** as false (AcroFormBuilder.cs:101). | #325 |
| adbe.pkcs7.sha1 | Never written. |  |
| adbe.x509.rsa_sha1 | Never written. |  |
| Encryption of FDF files | FDF not supported. |  |
| Suspects flag in MarkInfo | Never written. |  |
| UR signatures | Never written. |  |
| Transfer functions in the graphics state | Never written; must stay that way. | #256 |

## The ISO/TS extension series

"PDF 2.0" as deployed is not only ISO 32000-2:2020. Four Technical Specifications amend it, and a
fifth supplies structure-namespace rules it left undefined. Each is declared in a document through
a developer extensions dictionary (ISO 32000-2 7.12.3).

| Specification | Adds | ExtensionLevel | Status | Issue |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ISO/TS 32001:2022 | SHA-3 and SHAKE256 digests | 32001 | Not implemented | #238 |
| ISO/TS 32002:2022 | EdDSA and extended elliptic curves | 32002 | Not implemented | #239 |
| ISO/TS 32003:2023 | AES-GCM | 32003 | Not implemented | #236 |
| ISO/TS 32004:2024 | PDF MAC integrity protection | 32004 | Not implemented | #237 |
| ISO/TS 32005:2023 | PDF 1.7 and 2.0 structure namespace inclusion | - | Not implemented | #274 |

## The key-level delta

Derived from the Arlington PDF Model, which records `SinceVersion` and `DeprecatedIn` for every
key in the standard. Generated from its `tsv/2.0/` set (611 objects) — **not** `tsv/latest/`,
which carries two objects that are not part of PDF 2.0.

| | Count |
| --- | --- |
| Objects wholly new in PDF 2.0 | 44 |
| Objects gaining new keys | 99 |
| Objects with keys deprecated | 86 |
